Four monarch-informed stages remain in clockwise order: egg, larva, established hanging chrysalis and dorsal adult. Larval fine segment seams are omitted; three angled thoracic-leg cues and five straight proleg cues retain their count and distinct representative groups. Outlined prolegs become single strokes, not a detailed larval anatomy model. Front/rear filaments remain. Adult keeps four wing regions, a widened joined head/thorax/abdomen and enlarged outlined antennal clubs. Larva strokes remain 1.0 mm, adult body 1.2 mm and other original continuous outlines 1.4 mm; Index dots are freshly placed.
